from pyspark.sql.functions import col, regexp_extract, input_file_name

# Set your Storage account and container
storage_account_name = "darwinadls"
container_name = "darwinfs"

# Paths
raw_data_path = f"abfss://{container_name}@{storage_account_name}.dfs.core.windows.net/data/transcripts/"
curated_data_path = f"abfss://{container_name}@{storage_account_name}.dfs.core.windows.net/data/transcripts/curated/"
df_raw = spark.read.json(raw_data_path)

# Format data
df_with_exec = df_raw.withColumn("file_path", input_file_name())
df_with_exec = df_with_exec.withColumn("execution_id", regexp_extract(col("file_path"), "(transcript[0-9]+)\\.json", 1))
df_curated = df_with_exec.select("execution_id", "t", "p", "ts", "seq", "id")

df_curated.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(curated_data_path)
